title: mcp_tool_call_response
description: Response envelope for POST /v1/mcp/{server}/tools/{tool}. Carries the tool result alongside Recurse-specific provenance metadata: the run_id of the emitted attestation receipt and the policy decision that gated the call.

deny_reason.description: Human-readable cause when policy_decision == "deny". Null on allow.

trust_tier.description: Trust tier of the registry entry at call time. Quarantined ⇒ deny.

attested_run_id.description: run_id of the :mcp_tool_call attestation emitted for this call. Auditors deep-link from this value into the Audit Console.

result.description: Tool-specific result payload. Shape varies by tool. Null when policy_decision == "deny".
